bash:
set -e
spawned() { sed -nE 's/^Spawned .* \(([a-z0-9]+)\)$/\1/p'; }
a=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name to-minor --worktree HEAD --prompt 'Add a JSDoc line above toMinor and commit.' | spawned)
b=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name from-minor --worktree HEAD --prompt 'Add a JSDoc line above fromMinor and commit.' | spawned)
pstack-subagent wait "$a" --timeout 60
pstack-subagent wait "$b" --timeout 60
pstack-subagent stop "$a"
pstack-subagent stop "$b"

text: Both workers finished on their own branches. They ran on the session model, since no pstack-models.md line names one.
